notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.3.0511 – September 13, 2025
notes.content:
✨ Improvements

 Adjusted Spawner Mine collisions to prevent players, especially the Barbarian during Whirlwind, or rolling from getting stuck.
 Smoothed camera behavior during melee attacks to reduce jitter while preserving responsiveness.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.3.0495 – September 11, 2025
notes.content:
⚔️ Barbarian Enhancements

 Improved overall playability.
 When slightly out of melee range, pressing Melee or Interact while moving now makes the Barbarian leap forward to close the gap.
 Increased movement during Melee Combo Attacks for smoother combat flow.


🔊 Audio Adjustments

 Reduced volume of flesh impact sounds.
 Added a burning sound effect when the Sorceress’s Fire Beam hits a target.

notes.title: Trial of the Snake - Major Update – 1.0.3.0480
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307450/88bd3519939c2a605232ce77b2b393f55c9f2063.png"]
✨ New Content
3 New Levels – fresh challenges and dangers await!

Medusa Boss Fight – face the snake-haired terror and test your skills.

New Companion: Snake – harness poison powers with:

Venom Bite

Poison Bomb

Poison Ball

Toxic Bulb

Sacrifice ability that grants a Poison Buff

New Enemies – encounter deadly foes:

Horned

Snail 2

Snake

Eagle

New Agility Relic – boost your speed and maneuverability.
[hr][/hr]⚔️ Features & Improvements
Cave of the Bear – shrine replaced with a mighty Rock Golem Statue.

Shrine Tutorial – now included in the Tutorial Level for new players.

Enhanced Demon Warrior – new sounds make battles even more intense.

Crown Requirements – some levels now require a set number of crowns to unlock, adding progression depth.
[hr][/hr]🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed enemy combat distance issues.

Fixed players seeing their own reviver prompt (notably after stone shatter deaths).

Fixed stoning beam sound bug (no longer plays every frame).

Fixed horde spawns blocked by underground objects/terrain.

Fixed inactive companion behavior when spawning – they now wake up properly.

Shorter Repulsion Beam description to prevent overlapping text.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.2.0363 – July 31, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue with Coronation achievement

notes.title: Optimizing the Brigands Experience
notes.content:
✨ New Improvements
Several optimizations implemented for improved performance.

Reduced dependencies and overall memory usage.

Lowered streaming buffer pool size to optimize resource management.

Improved loading times across the game.

Reduced texture sizes for maximum efficiency without sacrificing visual quality.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.1.0283 – June 29, 2025
notes.content:
✨ New Features & Improvements

 Regular zombies now wear varied equipment and wield different weapons.
 Added death sounds to several enemy types.
 Fixed an issue where the Zombie Keeper’s club could still damage players after death.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.1.0262 – June 21, 2025
notes.content:
✨ New Features & Improvements

 Updated lighting in the lobby

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.1.0118 – June 11, 2025
notes.content:
✨ Bug Fixes

 Cave 5 – Echoes of Ja’sun: Added a blocking volume to prevent players from escaping an unintended area at the beginning of the level.


✨ New Features & Improvements

 Reduced the pushback impulse from Zombie Warrior (Keeper) attacks.
 Increased the volume of impact sounds from hammers and swords.
 Added knockdown and death sounds to several enemy types.
 Added visual and sound effects when zombies spawn.


Big thanks to Alex and Patrick for the helpful findings and suggestions.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.1.0015 – June 1, 2025
notes.content:
✨ Bug fixes and Tutorial Improvements

 Audio dialogue no longer overlaps: previous voice now stop before a new one plays
 Fixed an issue where picking up the first scroll in the tutorial wouldn’t trigger the next objective
 Resolved a bug in the Reflective Dome tutorial where too many imps would spawn and continue spawning even after the objective was completed
 Players can no longer run out of lives during the tutorial
 Prevented duplicate props (barrels and dummies) from being created when skipping dialogue with a button other than the interact button
 Fixed a misaligned collision box on the experience chest

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.1.0005 – May 31, 2025
notes.content:
✨ Forest 2 Improvements

 The waymark pointing to the village now also indicate the path to the next level
 Added a new waymark to assist with the "cut the tree with the wagon" puzzle
 Cleared and paved the path leading to that puzzle to better guide players
 Updated in-game text translations
 Fixed a French localization issue with "Waymark" now correctly labeled as "Panneau"
 The goal is to reduce confusion about where to go in the early levels, so players can enjoy the game without getting stuck.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.0.9933 – May 23, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed last crown location in Canyon 1

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.0.9930 – May 23, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed gamepad not working in pause menu

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.0.9897 – May 17, 2025
notes.content:
🔥 New Cave Level Unlocked!
Cave 5 – Echoes of Ja’sun is now live!
The level is located near Chelonian Wilds 1 and 2, and requires CW1 to be completed to unlock.
Huge thanks to Jason for sketching the initial layout of the level!

🪦 Tombstone Destruction Enabled:  Tombstones in Forest 1 and Cave 5 can now be shattered. 

🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed a few gameplay options that weren’t being applied before reaching the level selection screen.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.0.9843 – May 8, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the left stick was unresponsive on the Tally Screen.
 Relic tree no longer incorrectly displays permanent bonuses as relics.
 Fix for unresponsive pause menu when using a gamepad (may not fix all the issues)
 Huntress: Power shots (held arrow/secondary attack) are now disabled when the “Shoot Arrows” skill is not active.
 Increased the vitality of Cave Trolls by 15%.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9813 – April 29, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Prevent the Ratmancer (phase 1) to reorient towards anyone (the flying companions were causing the issue)

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9805 – April 28, 2025
notes.content:
✨ New Features for Caster characters (Huntress, Saboteur and Sorceress)

 Caster classes will no longer cast skill while holding the right mouse button. It will keep the strafe direction.
 Mouse middle button can be used to melee (caster classes)
 Mouse wheel up/down can be used to cycles through the selected skills
 Updated the list of inputs in option/key rebinding.


 MenuUp
 MenuDown
 MenuLeft
 MenuRight
 MenuSelect
 MenuBack
 MenuClear

 MenuAction

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9792 – April 27, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Paladin and Barbarian can only use Charge skills (Shield Charge, Furious Charge) with Evade button (PC) when Roll skill is not on the skill bar
 Barbarian’s Hammer Block will no longer work with secondary attack (Mouse right click) if the skill is not on the skill bar
 Fixed issue where pressing any mouse button could trigger Barbarian’s Furious Charge attack

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9781 – April 26, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the interaction HUD prompt would not appear for players other than Player 1.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9765 – April 25, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

Chelonian Wilds 1: adjusted path with walls to prevent players to leave the environment

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9750 – April 21, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where chest contents, especially gold from the Wild Thief, were not collectable.
 Chelonian Wilds 1: repositioned water body to hide the edge in the ditch area.
 Fixed missing sound when a snapping tortoise kills a snail.



✨ New Features & Changes

 Rebuilt all landscapes for Unreal Engine 5.4.
 Owl Companion: increased the chance to cast Multiply and Tornadoes.
 Added spawn and death sounds for the Zombie Boss.
 Adjusted the placement of several meshes and level markers on the level selection map.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9734 – April 15, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where platform splines weren't calculating direction properly.
 Fixed a floating siege tower moving in the wrong direction (Deadlands 1).

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9728 – Avril 15, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed scaling issue on character equipment
 Fixed visual bug with water bodies
 Fixed interaction bug involving levers and VFX destruction
 Fixed issue where relic chests from the Wild Thief incorrectly required payment
 Fixed a potential crash related to Elite Spawners


✨ New Features & Changes

 Improved AI navigation around Mine Spawners
 Companion icons now use opaque textures for better clarity
 Improved navigation in Canyon – Oasis: prevented out-of-bounds climbing and ensured the axe can't be thrown over the vine without proper destruction
 Refined the Saboteur’s behavior and enhanced the trajectory of the Infernal Axe when using bombs or bounce blades

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9672 – March 27, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue in map selection where respawning from Deadlands 1 could place the player in the goo lake.
 Adjusted landscape visibility in map selection to prevent seeing beyond the intended area at startup.
 Canyon Oasis: The end gate is now hidden until the axe reaches the oasis.
 Canyon 3 – Redoutable: The hot axe can no longer pass through orc wooden gates.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Upgraded the Unreal Engine to version 5.5.
 Added support for Epic Online Services (EOS).
 Updated lighting in the Citadel level to accommodate engine changes.
 Replaced the intro story image (wizard battle) with a new version.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9641 – March 21, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed persistent Dust of Light visual effects when repeating a sacrifice in the Citadel.
 Cemetery Gate: resolved shadow popping issues in the Deadlands.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Deadlands Summit: the path at the end is now blocked until the Zombie Boss is defeated.
 Saboteur Power: fixed a bug where throwing a bomb would incorrectly cast a Firewall. The power is now fully compatible with both Throw Bomb and Magnet Bomb skills.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9621 – March 18, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Totem Destruction (Deadlands): Resolved an issue where idle totem destruction occasionally blocked paths in the "4 Crystals" level.
 Tutorial Adjustment: Repositioned the tree at the exit gate to clear the path for the altar tutorial.
 SlimeMan Heal Station Freeze: Fixed a potential freeze at the SlimeMan heal station in the "4 Crystals" level.
 Projectile Behavior: Ensured that projectiles thrown onto spinning blades no longer stick in mid-air.
 Sound Issues: Addressed cases where projectiles, especially the Saboteur’s Bomb, were missing sound effects.
 Ice Chunk VFX: Corrected the impact visual effects during Crystal slashing to prevent screen flashing.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Snapping Tortoise: Added a unique death sound effect.
 Stun Immunity: After receiving three stun hits, characters will temporarily ignore further stun effects.
 Lightning Explosive Bolt: Introduced a distinctive lightning sound effect.
 Spinning Blade Improvements: Enhanced the Saboteur’s Spinning Blade's overlap checks with spawners, ensuring more consistent enemy damage.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9599 – March 13, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed a crash caused by projectiles registering invalid collisions for overlap.
 Fixed an issue in Forest 4 where wasps continued buzzing near the cemetery despite being invisible.
 Fixed a bug where the Saboteur’s Vanish skill was still detected by goats.

✨ New Features & Changes

 Character Lobby: When using a gamepad, the arrows next to the Back, Attributes, Companions, Skills, and Relics buttons will now be hidden when focus is on the Ready button, making the selection clearer.
 Forest 4: Added a new enemy wave between the tree stump and the collapsing tree (just before the wasps). Also introduced pumpkins.
 Crypt 1: Adjusted the lore book’s position to align with the exclamation mark.
 Added sound effects when unlocking the Toad and Owl companions using Dust of Light magic.
 Chelonian Wilds 1 & 2: Health orbs will now fully heal tortoises.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9589 – March 11, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed a texture swap crash when a tortoise gets frozen.
 Fixed a crash when attacking the practice dummy with Repulsion Surge.

✨ New Features & Changes

 Level Selection: Teleport names are now updated (e.g., Mushrooms → To the Chelonian Wilds).
 Respec Token: Upon purchase, a dialogue will now guide the player on where to use it.
 Village: Players can now climb the ruin tower near the respec token vendor.
 Saboteur starts with higher Intelligence and Strength.
 Increased damage of Explosive Bolt.
 Bouncing Blade skill description now clarifies that each rebound increases damage.
 Altar: Updated "Elemental required" to "Needs elemental" for clarity and to prevent text clipping.
 Shaman Totem: Increased vitality.
 Audio: Added sound effects for Ravenous Vortex.
 Credits: Updated.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9569 – March 9, 2025
notes.content:
✨ Huntress & Saboteur Updates

 Refined skill timing adjustments to better control when the next skill can be queued.
 Improved responsiveness for chaining or canceling a skill in progress when a new action is requested.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9565 – March 8, 2025
notes.content:
✨ Barbarian & Paladin Updates

 Refined skill timing adjustments to better control when the next skill can be queued.
 Improved responsiveness for chaining or canceling a skill in progress when a new action is requested.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9560 – March 7, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed certain Tallyscreen computations that incorrectly highlighted the wrong player.
 Forest 3: Resolved a boundary issue where players could get stuck to the left of the river, near the sandpit.
 HUD Fixes: The second player’s HUD (when a companion is spawned) will no longer cause the crown HUD to overlap with the objective HUD.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Cave of the Bear: The final corridor now has more enemies, increasing the challenge.
 Forest 1 Enemy Adjustments: Added Imps near the first altar. Added Wasps near the second altar. Ensures any class can trigger the altars when using elemental magic correctly.
 Loot System Improvement: Already unlocked weapons will no longer spawn as loot.
 Lobby UI Improvement: Selected buttons in the lobby now have a darker tint for better visibility.


Barbarian Responsiveness Updates:

 Leap Slam can now be canceled early, allowing faster attack chains.
 Whirlwind can be interrupted by a queued action.
 Cleave will no longer queue actions until the move becomes cancelable.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9544 – March 5, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Cave 1 – Fixed an environmental collision issue near the rail track (just past the cart) where characters could get stuck.
 Canyon 4 Oasis – Vines are now only vulnerable to damage from the Infernal Axe, as intended.
 Barbarian Block Skill – Resolved various issues, including movement speed inconsistencies, strafing problems, and unintended behavior while blocking.


✨ New Features & Changes

 New Sorceress Skill: Repulsion Surge 🔮
 Buff Indicator: Added an icon for the buff provided when charging.
 Input Adjustments: Removed alternate input.
 Barbarian Block Mechanic now utilizes the gamepad right stick for blocking unless Furious Charge is assigned to the skill bar.
 New Sound Effect: Added a distinct sound for acquiring a weapon.
 Players must manually choose to equip after acquiring.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9505 – March 2, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that prevented the Sorceress's save file from being overwritten when leaving the tutorial level.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9502 – March 1, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Forest 2: Fixed a blocking collision that prevented players from completing the puzzle leading to the village.
 Skyfallen Boss Fight: Fixed a bug where the boss was immune to Manitou, which is supposed to deliver the final blow.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Increased the casting sound volume when Orbital Spark spawns.
 Added a spawn sound for the Snowman.
 Introduced a spinning sound effect for the Barbarian’s Grapple Spin skill.

Barbarian – Hammer Mash Rework:

 No longer requires holding the skill button to continue mashing.
 The hammer mash will continue automatically up to the 7th hit, unless a queued skill or melee attack interrupts it.
 Players can now move while mashing.

Sorceress – Skill Adjustments:

 Two-Hand Cast skill has been disabled and will be replaced with a new skill soon.
 Sorceress can now interrupt a casted spell if another skill is triggered from the queue.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9491 – February 28, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed a crash related to the initialization of certain projectiles.

✨ New Features & Changes

 Expanded Skill Queuing System: Now available for the Barbarian, Huntress, Paladin, and Saboteur (previously exclusive to the Sorceress).

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9481 – February 27, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Forest 2: Fixed an issue where rocks in the puzzle push mechanic would become non-interactive due to slopes.
 Deadlands 1: Fixed falling rock behavior near the ballista—previously, destructibles were phasing through the siege tower instead of colliding with it.
 Deadlands 1: Adjusted vine destruction mechanics.
 Chelonian Wilds 2: Fixed an issue in the Hogriders' pit where their AI behaved erratically and failed to move toward players.

✨ New Features & Changes

 Hordes can no longer be summoned while affected by goo on platforms.
 New Achievement: "Training Complete" – Unlocked upon completing the tutorial.
 Experimental Skill Queuing for the Sorceress:
 One skill can now be queued while another action is in progress (e.g., Fireball, Tornado, Ice Shard).
 Firebeam can now be interrupted if another skill is pressed, even if the stick/mouse remains engaged.


🚀 Let us know your feedback on the new queuing system!

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9467 – February 26, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Undead Archer was not shooting arrows correctly.
 Resolved a projectile collision issue where being too close to an object (e.g., a Sorceress holding a staff that overlaps with a breakable) would prevent the projectile from hitting that object.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Improved AI Navigation: Enhanced pathfinding for companions and AI, especially on platforms.
 Deadlands 1 Adjustment: The level now starts with goo next to the tortoise.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9460 – February 25, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 D-PAD Icon: In dialogues, the icon now correctly displays the direction instead of just the symbol.
 Goo Projectiles: Resolved an issue where spit projectiles were affected by synergy.
 Boss Fights: Disabled goo-triggered hordes during boss encounters.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Updated the French translations for Tutorial and recent lore.


Cobol - Ratmancer Boss Fight (3rd Phase Only)

 Fixed a spitting bug.
 Goo spitting no longer creates puddles.
 The Ratmancer’s staff is no longer available for attack.
 You can now directly damage Cobol with melee or projectile attacks.
 Rotating balls can now be aimed at Cobol and will damage him.
 Projectile autotargeting is disabled during the third phase of the boss fight.
 Improved collision handling for rotating balls: once hit, they ignore environmental obstacles (colliding only with Cobol) and can be affected by tornadoes.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9439 – February 24, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 The invincibility effect from the Sorceress’s Force Shield no longer appears as a buff icon.

✨ New Features & Changes
Tutorial Added:

 A new tutorial level is now available before Forest 1. In this level, you play as the Sorceress. The tutorial needs to be completed only once (although you have the option to skip it), and it will then be unlocked for all your characters.

Enhanced Damage Indicators:

 The Barbarian’s Pillars of the Earth skill and the "Pillars to Break" mechanic during the SkyFallen boss fight now feature an indicator that clearly shows where the damage will occur. Additionally, the skill’s angles and direction have been reworked to provide a more intuitive indication of the damage area.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9406 – February 19, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

Chelonian Wilds 2: Fixed combat and music alternance bug at the beginning if players skips the 
hogriders
✨ New Features & Changes

 Village vendors are now selling weapons and relics, and the stock renews itself every 20 minutes.
 Chelonian Wilds 1: last snapping tortoise will not be spawned in easy
 Chelonian Wilds 2: reduced amount of enemies in easy mode

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9369 – February 15, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Chelonian Wilds 3: Fixed starting point placement.

✨ New Features & Changes

 Snapping tortoises, Aqua Dracos, and Hogriders with indicators will no longer be affected by speed boosts in Hard difficulty, ensuring intended challenge balance.
 Chelonian Wilds 3 Adjustments:
      - Added two mushroom speed boosts at the end of the level for impatient players (available in Easy and Normal difficulties, but not Hard).
       - Reduced the number of snapping tortoises in Easy difficulty for better pacing.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9362 – February 14, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Adjusted Citadel outro story duration for better pacing.
 Tornado no longer affects ballista interactions.
 Firewalls, icewalls, and skill-spawned items will now properly pass through spawners instead of snapping on top.

✨ New Features & Changes

 Dialogue Pausing: Characters and projectiles now pause during dialogues, ensuring better readability and immersion.
 Ice Shard Collision Improvement: Increased height-wise collision size to improve interactions with breakables.
 Crypt 1 Secret Enhancement:
    - Added a button that infinitely spawns a Ghoul Boss until the player figures out how to solve the puzzle.
    - Makes the secret more fun and intuitive to discover.
 Skill Renaming:
    - "Meteor Shower" has been renamed to "Rain of Fire" for both the Sorceress and power-up variant.
 Deadlands 1 Adjustments:
    - Added potions and food for better resource management.
    - Adjusted wall boundaries.
    - The starting area now features a tortoise and a ladder (visual enhancement only).
 Deadlands 4 Tweaks:
    - Removed the achievement and hard difficulty unlock at the end of the level, which was originally in place before the Citadel was added.
 Canyon 1:
    - Foliage adjustments for improved visual consistency.
 Forest 3:
    - Adjusted objective names for better clarity.
 Chelonian Wilds 3:
    - Smoothed landscape near the final checkpoint for better traversal.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9341 – February 13, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed Forest 2 starting at wrong location

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9339 – February 13, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Hardcore Novice achievement could be obtained in the village.
 Resolved a bug in Forest 3 (pit area) where destroying the vine without first killing the Festering Ghoul would prevent enemy spawns (archers and mines).
 Fixed an infinite roll exploit caused by a conflict with the Furious Charge skill.
 Addressed a sound issue occurring exclusively on Siege Tower when using the Tornado + Firewall synergy.
 Adjusted the slide duration in the Citadel Intro story sequence.


New Features & Changes

 New Boss: Cursed King boss fight is now available.
 Village Vendors: Relics and weapons at the vendor/blacksmith are now randomized.
 Goat Nerf: Goat vitality has been significantly reduced, making it nearly a one-hit kill.
 Forest 3 Fix: Objective and indicator locations are now properly aligned.
 Paladin Buff: Added sound effects to the Shield Charge skill.
 Relics Rework:
    - Relic costs have been reduced.
    - Passive abilities are now categorized as Relic Slots.
 Canyon 2 Arena: Reduced snail movement speed.
 Level Selection Map Updates:
    - Added an arrow in Chelonian Wilds 1 (near the first checkpoint) to indicate the correct path.
    - Chelonian Wilds 2 has been moved closer to the Deadlands Bridge to reflect the correct path.
forward.
 Altar Buffs: Attacking an altar now automatically grants its buff.
 Boss Chest Loot:
    - Boss chests now prioritize loot matching the player's class.
    - Increased the probability of receiving loot for the current class from 60% → 75%.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9309 – February 12, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Mine 1: Fixed an issue where players couldn’t switch tracks after looping around at the starting area.
 Village: Checkpoints now correctly start at the armory if it was previously chosen, instead of defaulting to the market.
 Forest 2: Adjusted the position of a killing box that was affecting an unintended area near the cart, just before the wasp nests.

✨ New Features & Changes

 Village: Increased the cost of companions to 3500 gold (was 1000).
 Forest 4 Updates:
    - Added new enemies in the cemetery.
    - Tweaked fog effects for improved atmosphere in the cemetery.
    - Increased the availability of food and potions.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9300 – February 11, 2025
notes.content:
🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the healing circle spawned by buffs and weapons wasn’t properly destroying itself after a set duration.
 Resolved a bug where a buff intended to spawn an actor during an attack could not trigger early—the actor can now be spawned as intended.


✨ New Features & Changes

 Companions no longer collide with pushable objects.
 Horde sizes have been doubled for increased challenge.
 Forest 1: A zombie wave now spawns upon reaching the Shaman’s area.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9292 – February 10, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue with some enemies spawning in the ground during hordes
 Fixed issue with skipped dialogue that kept going with the interact button even after leaving the interactive object
 Fixed a problem with Treasure lizard that was starting its destruction timer even before appearing on screen

New Features & Changes

 Treasure lizard: now with a purple outline to see it through objects

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9284 – February 9, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed raycast detection issues for neutral enemies when using beam attacks.
 Added support for neutral enemies affected by Lightning Arc (marked for shock) and the Grappling Hook.
 Adjusted invisible floor filters to improve behavior for flying enemies.
 Fixed an issue where tornadoes were being blocked by wasps.
 Fixed bouncing blades occasionally bouncing off firewalls unexpectedly.
 Fixed a bug preventing hordes from spawning if another horde was already active in the level.
 Fixed camera clipping issues near the secret treasure in Cave 1.


New Features & Changes

 Cave 1: Added a spiked roof above the secret chest to enhance environmental hazards.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9274 – February 7, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Removed tornado buff from the Eminence Staff.
 Fixed visual alignment issues with Staves Buff VFX.


New Features & Changes

 Reduced the impact radius of Fireball.
 Decreased impulse force on breakable and destructible objects.
 Added a Sacrifice Orb to Crypt 1 - Secret 1.
 Improved the destructible wall in Crypt 1 - Secret 2.
 Fire DoT VFX is now smaller and features a deeper red hue.
 Replaced the Firebomb VFX with a new visual effect.
 Enabled horde encounters in non-forest levels.
 Saboteur Engineering Points have been removed. Damage scaling now relies on Strength and Intelligence.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9258 – February 4, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed multishot projectile angles.
 Fixed Lava Elemental’s ability to abuse random power.
 Fixed arrows getting stuck on firewalls.
 Fixed scaling issues with the Flaming Bouncing Blade.
 Fixed radial damage inconsistencies with the "Throw Rock" skill.
 Fixed Ice Shard being blocked by breakables when piercing.


Rock Golem Updates

 Reduced charge speed.
 Charge attack now includes footstep sounds.
 Added sound effect to the spawn state.
 Updated rock throw damage values.
 Adjusted walking/running animation speed based on size and level.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9234 – February 2, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed outdated version of the Crypt level.
 Paladin skill Heaven’s Grasp in the lobby now displays the correct damage value.


New Features & Changes

 Added new lore and a hidden hint to the Crypt.
 Implemented impact tables for enemy weapons.
 Introduced Monster Power starting from Forest 4 onward:
 • Enemies have increased health and deal more damage.
 • Defeating them grants more XP, gold, and loot.
 Adjusted text for boss names and skills (English & French).

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9234 – January 31, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Deadland 1: Fixed siege tower collision.
 Fixed an issue where charge actions (Juggernaut, Shield Charge, Furious Charge) could cancel certain skills.
 Fixed a visual bug where the shield did not block some projectiles.
 Fixed an audio issue when skipping the story.


New Features & Changes

 Deadland 1: The siege tower now deals damage while moving.
 Updated French translation.
 Revamped difficulty menu, now displaying more details.
 Easy difficulty: No elite enemies.
 Hard difficulty: Increased elite enemy presence and higher enemy movement speed.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9220 – January 25, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Added an XP cap to spawners with intervals (similar to Hogriders).
 Fixed an issue where the Icewall would instantly break when cast by the Frost Dragon.
 Goo slowdown no longer affects animation speed during roll actions.
 Fixed a bug causing rolling spikes to occasionally get stuck instantly.
 Resolved a rolling spike collision issue in co-op that caused unintended teleportation.
 Fixed the first snail exit in Canyon 2.


New Features & Changes

 Increased the volume of all voiceovers.
 The Cave Troll now has a spawn state where he shouts before taking any action.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9209 – January 24, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue in Cobol’s Phase 2 fight where he was incorrectly immune to damage.


New Features & Changes

 Added sound effects for explosive and fire arrows.
 Increased the volume of Citadel voiceovers for better clarity.
 Adjusted damage values for the Cursed King.
 Extensive balancing of experience and life points, with a focus on elites and bosses.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9198 – January 23, 2025
notes.content:
New Features & Changes

 Increased the overall volume of all voiceovers.
 Improved HogRider's charge and wall detection.
 Reduced the Snail’s movement speed.


Environment Adjustments
Canyon 1:

 Raised the landscape at the end of the level to prevent enemy pop-in.
 Reworked the canyon's shape for better flow.
 Added a rolling spike trap to prevent players from rolling back onto Aggobo.
 Adjusted audio for a more immersive experience.

Canyon 2:

 Increased density and combat encounters after the trap.
 The arena has been reworked—no more fight waves after the snails.
 Relocated crowns and chests for better pacing.
 Added sound effects when orcs arrive.
 Introduced a checkpoint before the arena.
 The end of the level in the arena is now more intense and challenging.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9174 – January 21, 2025
notes.content:
New Features & Changes

 French localization pass completed.
 Huntress: The charged arrow attack is now more powerful.
 New Sorceress Staves:
    - Eminence – No special power.
    - Hydra – Increases the impact radius of fireballs.
 Meteor Skill Update: Now optimized for low-end PCs, appearing as a fiery rain instead of large falling boulders.
 Added two new secret chests.
 Weapon drops now maintain a minimum enforced distance to avoid clustering.


Environment Adjustments
Village:

 Updated lighting to reduce excessive glow.
 Added a new weapon rack to accommodate the two new staves.

Cave 3 (SkyFallen):

 Introduced a small water puddle for added environmental detail.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9151 – January 19, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a potential exploit that allowed opening the boss chest without completing the level.
 Increased the volume for Citadel Outro voice lines.
 Flying characters will now properly fall into goo ponds.


New Features & Changes

 Improved AI behavior for flying characters, enhancing their ability to avoid targeting or attacking enemies out of reach.
 Added a warning voice for Cobol.
 Updated the Owl companion's icon.
 The Holy Damage relic effect has been changed from an aura to a hands-based visual effect (VFX).
 Mushroom levels (Tortoise biome) have been renamed to “Chelonian Wilds.”


Environment Adjustments
Cave 2 – SkyFallen:

 Added level sequences for the entrances to Phases 2 and 3, featuring broken rocks and improved timing for transitions.

Citadel:

 Increased the number of enemies and added more spawners for the boss fight.
 The Cursed King is now more resistant.
 Prevented enemy spawns in out-of-combat zones.

Deadlands:

 Slime heads on the siege tower will no longer be driven by the navmesh incorrectly.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9123 – January 16, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a culling issue with grass and flowers in mushroom levels.
 Rolling rocks now instantly kill Snapping Tortoises as intended.
 Hurt animations are no longer slowed down by the goo effect.


New Features & Changes
Audio Enhancements:

 Added voiceovers for stories, lore, and most dialogues (English only).

Co-op Improvements:

 When a player picks up a scroll, all living players in the session now receive one.

Tortoise Mode Adjustments:

 Removed collisions in multiplayer for Tortoise Mode.
 Added anticipation to the camera, positioning it in the direction the tortoises are headed.


Environment Adjustments
Cave 2 – SkyFallen:

 Reduced the damage dealt by ground pillars.
 Fixed a bug where a ground pillar could get stuck in the air near the entrance to the third phase.
 Updated music transitions after SkyFallen is defeated.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9102 – January 14, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Companions are no longer considered for totem detection.
 Rolling rocks will now roll when hit by AI only if the rock is being rendered.
 Fixed an issue where the Sorceress’ fireballs were blocked by a Paladin standing in her path.
 Resolved an issue with some Paladin shields not changing materials when reflecting.

Demon Warrior:

 Adjusted idle, walk, and run animations to reduce the floating/skating effect.
 Reduced damage to match that of the Cave Troll.
 Decreased melee attack range to ensure hits land within range.


New Changes

 Pushables’ interaction prompt now says: “Hold [KEY] to move” instead of “Press…”
 Bonus life is now based on the party's average level.
 Default skills for Paladin and Barbarian now include the Roll ability.
 Updated credits.
 Passive abilities now unlock at levels 6, 16, and 26, with a HUD prompt similar to a level-up notification.
 Hidden Secrets: Each class now has a hidden weapon, discoverable in secret chests throughout the game.
 Random relics can now be purchased for a cost between 3 and 12 scrolls (previously a fixed 10).
 Decreased speed, acceleration, and final distance for all Roll actions.
 Whirlwind is now cancelable, with a cancel frame and added sound effects in the montage.
 Reduced Paladin’s sword slash damage.
 Increased Barbarian’s hammer slash damage.
 Barbarian’s attack speed slightly increased.
 Increased base arrow damage for Huntress.
 Increased HP for the Keeper (first zombie boss).
 Stunned AI characters in the air now receive a forced downward velocity.
 Fire Arrows now always multishot.
 Fire Arrow Multishot Buff:
 Adds +2 additional multishots.
 Increases shots before cooldown by two.
 Regular Fire Arrows can now shoot 3 times before cooldown (was 2).
 Buff and weapon descriptions updated accordingly.


Environment Adjustments

Cave 1:

 Added a new secret zone with a chest.
 Adjusted landscape in the mushroom area and added numerous spikes. The zone under the giant mushroom is now a death trap and cannot be accessed.
 Fixed collisions on the final path to the exit near the mine static mesh (close to the mine wagon Ratkin).
 Adjusted landscape near the second crown (slightly shifted the crown) to prevent camera clipping issues
.

Citadel:


 Blocked a path to prevent players from wandering into an empty area.
 Adjusted the final story sequence so the interactor matches the player’s class.


Deadland 3:


 Adjusted landscape near the goo-covered trees (altar boulder).
 Increased the slope size on the left of the final zone with the crystal to prevent players from bypassing the area.
 Added an altar near the hidden zone.


Deadland 4:


 Cave Troll in Deadland 4 is invincible until released from its cage.
 Updated combat music to avoid clashing with Wild Thief’s theme.


Forest 2:


 Adjusted landscape at the beginning of the level.
 Modified the cart zone:
 The fallen tree now lands higher, reducing its penetration into the hill.
 Players can now pass underneath the fallen tree.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9068 – January 12, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the game incorrectly identified the Ratkins controlling wagons as a Mine level, triggering the tutorial.
 The Mine 3 Tally Screen now displays experience and damage stats, just like in a regular level.
 The Tally Screen no longer shows a gold bonus for levels without crowns.
 Resistance multipliers no longer ignore the resistance cap for DOT (damage over time) durations.
 Lowered the collision box for goo lakes.
 Adjusted the Deadland 4 landscape for a hidden zone.


New Changes

 Level names are now visible from the map selection screen, even for locked levels.
 The Treasure Lizard’s idle fade-out timer will only start once it has been rendered on screen and the player is detected.
 Players riding tortoises are now immune to goo.
 Cobol will display “immune” when receiving regular damage.
 In Cobol Phase 3, sound effects now play when the staff receives the rotating ball.


Environment Adjustments
Mine 1

 Adjusted the landscape at the ending for better visibility.

Mine 2

Adjusted trigger overlaps.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9041 – January 10, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where Hanitou’s ground AOE damage did not affect SkyFallen.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.9039 – January 10, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the red class requirement prompt for chests did not display correctly.
 Resolved wagon overlapping issues that prevented players from switching tracks.
 Fixed Saboteur’s strafing animations.
 Prevented the Infernal Axe from bouncing upward infinitely.


New Changes

 Paladin’s shield throw now has distinct actions for running and stationary positions.
 Pushbacks are now handled differently: players can be lightly hit several times over a short period before their state is interrupted.
 SkyFallen now plays a hurt sound when taking damage.
 Saboteur has a new set of roll, strafe, idle, walk, and run animations.
 Paladin and Barbarian now have a “Roll” skill.
 Roll animations now include sound effects.
 Slight reordering of skill level requirements for most classes.
 Hasty Staff: changed its power from “Spawn 3 tornadoes” to “Tornado spins faster.”
 Sorceress’ Force Field skill now casts much faster.
 Wild Thief’s chest indicator will disappear after a short time.
 Ratkin Ballista is now immune to goo.
 Vengeful Arrow and Heaven’s Grasp projectiles now prioritize enemies closer to the player.
 Added a delay between each of Heaven’s Grasp’s explosions.


Environment Adjustments

Mine 3

 Added two giant death traps to prevent players from falling between the spikes under the rails at the beginning.
 Flattened the ground before the wagon, making it easier to fight and collect items.
 Adjusted wagon triggers.


Village

 Now features two entrances on the level selection screen: one for weapons and one for vendors.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8993 – January 7, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue in the lobby where max stats could exceed the limit per class.
 The Wild Thief Shaman’s chest will now spawn 180 degrees rotated to align with him and will no longer block pathways.


New Changes

 Added a sizzling sound effect when a character with a fire DOT enters water.
 Replaced the visual effects for the Paladin’s healing aura.
 Reduced Paladin’s sword slash damage from 2 to 1.5.
 The relic icon (vendor) now features a transparent background.
 Vendors, chests, and weapons will now display class requirements, if applicable.
 Redoutable Boss Fight Rework: When Redoutable is hit by the Infernal Axe, he becomes vulnerable to regular attacks (and loses his fire effect) for 5 seconds.
 Added an arrow indicator to the Infernal Axe (found in the Redoutable and Oasis levels), which remains until it takes its first damage.

SkyFallen:

 Now fully immune to regular damage, with an “Immune” popup displayed for clarity.


Environment Adjustments

 Forest 3: Added water puddles to help cool down SkyFallen’s Burning attacks.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8972 - January 4, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Resolved an issue with the tally screen not displaying correctly when previously collapsed in certain game modes.
 Fixed a bug that allowed the system to save weapons not supported by the character's class.
 Weapon equip: ensured interactions now prioritize the last overlapping actor, preventing players from equipping incompatible gear.
 Mine 3: Fixed collision near the bear encounter—right before the mushroom jump—to prevent players from getting stuck.


New Changes
Reworked SkyFallen Boss Fight:

 New music introduced for added atmosphere.
 Updated camera ratio and HUDs during the intro sequence.
 Added environmental elements: stairs and falling rocks.
 Whip attack now applies a fire DoT (damage over time) instead of knockdown.
 Combo attack (slash, slash, whip) includes movement for better fluidity.

Phase 1 Changes:

 Water color changed to green for better visibility (done in phase 2 as well).
 Collapsing pillars now spawn ground pillars, which the player can use to attack SkyFallen.
 Added health orbs in Phase 1 to aid the player.

Phase 3 Entrance:

 Introduced blocking rocks at the phase transition.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8951 - January 3, 2025
notes.content:
A Huge Shoutout to saresyn!
We want to extend a massive, heartfelt THANK YOU to saresyn for their incredible help in identifying and reporting all these bugs and issues. Your sharp eye and dedication have been invaluable to improving the game. From tracking down tricky AI behaviors to uncovering obscure environmental glitches, you’ve gone above and beyond, and we couldn’t be more grateful. Your contributions have made a significant impact, and we are so lucky to have you on this journey. THANK YOU, saresyn—you’re an absolute legend!

Bug Fixes

 Map Selection: Resolved an issue where the landscape changed shape with camera movement.
 Character Lobby: Backing out from skills, companions, or relics with a gamepad now automatically saves the configuration.
 Option Menu: The last selected option is now remembered and focused on when returning to the menu.
 Hanitou Ground Attack: Fixed the attack location, bringing it closer to the fists.
 AI Targeting: Fixed an issue where AI characters sometimes fixated on seeking dead targets.
 Altar Interactions: Fixed a bug where certain altars became "dead," preventing them from receiving elemental damage.
 Vendor Expenses: Excluded vendor expenses from the gold count in the tally screen.


New Changes

 Mine Wagon Controls: Added an alternate key to switch tracks on the Mine Wagon (press "Space" on PC).
 Griffin Projectiles: After the Sacrifice, all projectiles from the Griffin are now removed.
 Fire DOT Buff: Fire damage-over-time effects are now automatically removed from the player when they jump into water.


Environment Adjustments

 Mine 1, 2, and 3: Adjusted surrounding landscapes to fit the zoomed-out camera.
 Mine 3: Refined the environment around the spiral track to prevent camera clipping.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8928 - January 2nd, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Resolved an issue where the Frost Dragon's Ice Wall skill would break instantly upon casting.
 Fixed a crash occurring during boss fights when the player had never defeated the boss, died, respawned, and then killed it.


New Changes

 Health potion vendors can now appear randomly in levels, similar to random chests and relic vendors.
 Improved accuracy of tally screen stats, especially in Mine Wagon mode.
 Tally screen now hides unused stats in Mine Wagon and Tortoise modes.
 Mine Wagon tutorial now pauses the wagons for clarity.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8916 - January 2nd, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Resolved a crash issue when an ice wall is destroyed by a mine wagon.
 Adjusted altar mechanics to properly support raw and buffed elemental damage, with special emphasis on holy damage.


New Changes
Quality of Life Improvements:

 Food and health orbs now display as "Full" when the player's health bar is at 100%, preventing unnecessary pickups.

Relic Shop Update:

 The relic chest is now pre-opened and accompanied by a vendor for a more streamlined purchasing experience.


New Content
New Paladin Skill: Heaven’s Grasp

 A powerful addition to the Paladin’s skillset, delivering divine justice.

Skill Update:

 The Holy Damage skill has been reworked and is now a Paladin-specific relic.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8909 - January 1st, 2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the crown gold bonus wasn’t awarded in Tortoise and Mine Wagon modes.
 Fixed a rare crash caused by the replicated particle system component.
 Resolved an issue where crowns were not visible in the level selection menu.
 Mine Wagon: Corrected camera settings when restarting from a checkpoint.


New Changes

 Updated hint descriptions for better clarity.
 Mine Wagon: Prevented track swapping to the opposite direction while holding a direction input.
 Mine Wagon (Multiplayer): Increased the camera distance for a better view.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8896 - December 31, 2024
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Sorceress's Dash Forward now properly stops when blocked by the environment.
 Fixed animation transitions from falling/knockback states when the player dies.
 Corrected the starting location in Forest 2.


New Changes

 Paladin's Ground Lightning animation speed has been doubled.
 Paladin's Shield Throw is now homing, targeting nearby enemies.
 Updated names and descriptions for Relics and Saboteur skills.


Environment Adjustments

Forest 2

 Corrected the starting location.
 Fixed collision for pushable rocks to prevent getting stuck in the fence during the village puzzle.

Forest 3

 Added splash sound effects when falling into the river.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8879 - December 30, 2024
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a collision issue with a chopped tree: players can no longer pass through it during respawn (invincibility phase).
 Resolved a collision issue with a burning tree: Whirlwind can no longer pass through it.
 Fixed cooldown behavior for the Barbarian’s 4th attack Whirlwind weapon power.
 Sorceress's Orbital Spark now collides with Altars as intended.


New Changes

 Improved Paladin sword combos for better responsiveness, increased damage, and faster execution.
 Barbarian's Hammer Block can now be used while moving.
 Orbital Spark now deals lightning damage (previously fire damage).
 Mine Spawner: Destroying it now kills all enemies within the mine's radius.


Environment Adjustments

Forest 3

 Adjusted collision for a rock with a bear on top (located near two spawners, before the archers and cart).
 SkyFallen now automatically detects players upon spawning, triggering combat music.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8864 - December 30, 2024
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Adjusted melee attacks for Paladin and Barbarian: they can now cancel the end of their attack animations when holding a direction.
 Standardized outlines for all classes: Sorceress and Huntress now have the same outline as other classes.
 Added outlines to human enemies for better visibility.
 Fixed Barbarian's weapon power: the 4th melee attack (Whirlwind) now works correctly even when Whirlwind isn’t equipped as a skill.
 Sorceress's Meteor skill now requires level 27.
 Resolved an issue causing players to get stuck in the stun state.


Environment Adjustments

Forest 2

 Added sound effects for cart placement: a success sound plays when placed correctly, and a fail sound when moved outside the correct area.

Forest 3

 Convoy marching sound now loops correctly.
 Fixed combat music triggering during the convoy fight.
 Added an indicator to guide players after obtaining the crystal.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8848 - December 29, 2024
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a potential crash when respawning from a platform.
 Adjusted and raised Tornado sound effects.
 Corrected music classifications so they now respond to the “Music” volume slider in options.


New Features

 The Force Field now uses a distinct material if reflective.
 Updated passive ability requirements to 5, 15, and 25.
 Added a “tip” on the tally screen suggesting players visit the lobby if there are unassigned attributes.
 Early Access Only: Completing the final Deadlands level (Summit) now unlocks the next difficulty and triggers the "Beat the Game" achievement.
 Players who damage an untriggered altar with physical attacks will now see a hint: "Elemental required" to help new players understand the altar's purpose.


Environment Adjustments
Forest 2

 Increased space for pushing the cart to prevent players from getting stuck; replaced with a longer tree for chopping.
 Improved the platform when crossing the chopped tree to reduce unnecessary falls.

Forest 3

 Added a new objective: Destroy the spawners.
 Fixed objective refreshing issues when respawning at a checkpoint.

Cave 1

 Added a new objective in Zone 03: Block the wagons.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8827 - December 28, 2024
notes.content:
Update Notes 0.1.0.8827 - December 28, 2024

A big thank you to Petou for identifying a critical bug!

Bug Fixes


 Fixed the level transition from Crypt 1 to Mine 3.
 Aggobo's attacks now deal unblockable damage, except for Earth Slide, which remains blockable by design.


New Features

Introducing new unique powers for all weapon classes!
Each class now has 7 weapons with exclusive abilities:

Swords

 Sun Seeker Sword: Divine Beams now heal allies.
 Scaled Edge Sword: Critical hits trigger Marked for Judgement.
 Shark Tooth Sword: Blocking with a shield may petrify the attacker.


Staves

 Hailstorm Staff: Fires multishot Ice Shards instead of one.
 Hasty Staff: Casts 3 Tornadoes instead of one.
 Glowing Crescent Staff: Firebeam triggers an explosive discharge.


Crossbows

 Fruloop Crossbow: Casting Vanish also creates a healing circle.
 Windcaller Crossbow: Increases blade length on Spinning Trap.
 Hunter’s Boon Crossbow: Grants a healing bonus for kills with Foe Buster.


Hammers

 The Rock Hammer: One Stomp Closer has a chance to spawn Pillars of the Earth.
 Golden Pound Hammer: The 4th combo attack is Whirlwind.


Bows

 Brisk Bow: Fire Arrow now fires multiple shots.


Enjoy the latest update, and thank you for your continued support! 💖

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8811 - December 16, 2024
notes.content:
A huge thank you to Roberto Silva M for helping us identify so many issues!

New Features
Tallyscreen

 Replaced the “Main Menu” button with “Lobby.”
 The Lobby will now have focus if players have new attributes.

Shaitan Sword

 Now has a chance to trigger a life leech buff on melee attacks.

Updated Level Names and Numbers

 Adjusted the naming/numbering system for cave levels.

Saboteur Class

 Added a delay between consecutive air attacks.

Environment Adjustments
Forest 3

 Fixed a bounding issue that could cause the player to get stuck.
 Adjusted the tree-chopping visual effects to appear closer to the trunk.

Mine 1

 Prevented characters from walking on rails at the starting area.

Mine 2

 Made the second crown easier to pick up.

Cave 1

 Fixed an area near the bears where players could get stuck (next to the moving rock).
 Resolved a bounding volume issue at the start where players could move out of bounds.

Cave 3 (SkyFallen)

 Moved the pillars further away from the walls to improve navigation.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.0.8797 - December 14, 2024
notes.content:
New Features

 Tooltips Added: Tooltips now display on the player HUD for potions, gold, scrolls, skills, and more.
 Character-Specific Story Endings: Each character class now has its own unique story conclusion.
 Enhanced Rolling Rocks: Rolling Rocks can now be triggered by enemy contact.
 XP Popups: A "+XP" popup appears when collecting yellow orbs.
 Attribute Notification: A new HUD icon ("+") alerts players when attributes are available to set.
 Detailed Attribute Panel: A new detail panel in the Lobby shows the function of each attribute.


Bug Fixes

 Removed spawning sounds from spawners.
 Fixed altar issue: altars with a starting element no longer play unnecessary sounds.
 Corrected the direction of breakable object destruction (e.g., barrels when broken by Firebeam).
 Firebeam:
 No longer collides with collectibles.
 No longer triggers unintended AoE effects with an elemental buff.
 Fixed collision filtering for large crates.
 Resolved gamepad cycling issue in the Lobby/Attributes panel when no attributes were available to set.


Environment Adjustments
The Crypt 1:

 Added two new lore entries.
 Lore 3 moved from the coffin to a nearby location.
 Introduced new areas with books.
 The ending sequence now includes more action and is gated by a locked door.

Forest 2:

 Adjusted bridge collision for smoother traversal.

Forest 3:

 Fixed mine collision issue when the Saboteur or Huntress rolls into it.
 Paved the path in the dome/pit area for improved navigation.

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.8769 - December 11, 2024
notes.content:
Update 0.1.0.8769 - December 11, 2024

Bug Fixes:


 Resolved an issue where DOT VFX failed to attach properly in non-debug builds.
 Fixed multiple issues with the Wild Thief event:
 Corrected the chest's spawn location to prevent it from being too far from the shaman.
 Fixed thieves spawning inside collision areas, which prevented waves from completing.
 Addressed a crash that occurred during character actions when spawning a projectile.
 Fixed the game not pausing correctly when accessing the options menu from the pause menu.
 Resolved an issue with sliders in the options menu (controls and audio) not saving changes properly.


Environment Adjustments:


 Improved environment design to prevent falling, going out of bounds, and taking unintended shortcuts:
 Forest 2: Adjusted various areas.
 Cave of the Bear: Fixed navigation issues.
 Added undead enemies near the cemetery in Forest 1.
 Forest 2: Disabled the ability to push a rock in the village area until the barrels are destroyed.

notes.title: Update 8754 for December 9th
notes.content:
Cave of the bear is no longer accessible from Forest 1.
 The entrance to the cave has been replaced by a chest containing the first weapon upgrade.
 Picked up crown visual is now silver
 It is now possible to navigate through menu using the left stick of a gamepad
 Updated skill descriptions
